svg.title: Pharmacy App Prototype — architecture
svg.desc: Pharmacy App Prototype: Inspired by Apollo Pharmacy · built in 135 minutes at CoinQuest. Built in 135 minutes for the CoinQuest Hackathon, where it won first prize, this prototype explores how a pharmacy app can make finding a medicine and its details quick. Its source wasn't available, so the flow is conceptual.
